## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `cmp32` (32-bit registered unsigned comparator: y = (a < b)) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module cmp32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [0:0] y_o
);

wire lt_0 = (a_i[31:0] < b_i[31:0]);
wire eq_0 = (a_i[31:0] == b_i[31:0]);

wire cmp_0 = lt_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 1'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= cmp_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274.

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll restructure the comparator as an explicit balanced prefix tree (lt/eq pairs) instead of letting Yosys infer a ripple subtractor, which should cut logic depth substantially.

Baseline-like result — the tree didn't help, so ABC likely re-derives a similar netlist. Let me try a structurally very different, much smaller mux-based comparator (fewer cells → shorter wires) plus a flop-input restructuring that keeps the reset AND off the data path.

Interesting: both restructurings came out *worse* — WNS tracks area (bigger netlist → longer wires), and the baseline's yosys-generated subtractor is apparently the leanest AIG for ABC. Let me keep the baseline comparator exactly and only restructure the flop input logic so the reset AND is off the `cmp` data path (mux only, 1 gate instead of 2).

Current best is 76.06 (sub-3, baseline comparator + leaner flop-input path). A worse final submission can't reduce my recorded best, so I'll take one free shot at shortening the comparator depth: 8-bit group compares combined in a balanced 2-level tree, keeping the winning register structure.
